reason_descriptions.china_domain: Exact suffix in the configured v2fly China input, including its category path. No checked Sukka reject match.
reason_descriptions.china_ip: Exact Sukka China CIDR with no-resolve. APNIC registration covers the prefix in China, GeoLite identifies its full range as CN, and no reject CIDR overlaps.
reason_descriptions.speedtest: Exact hostname in the configured Sukka Speedtest category, with public DNS answers and no checked domain or IP reject match.
reason_descriptions.speedtest_missing_dns: Sukka lists the host, but Google DNS returned NXDOMAIN for A and AAAA, confirmed by Cloudflare DNS. Held pending a working endpoint.
reason_descriptions.global_source: Exact rule in a configured Global provider. Any recorded Sukka reject hits apply to individual child names of the independently classified service.
reason_descriptions.global_official: The official service source identifies this exact API endpoint or service suffix and supports its Global classification.
reason_descriptions.global_arkose: The configured GlobalAI provider VPSDance gives this exact hostname as a suffix for a Microsoft Copilot dependency.
reason_descriptions.global_keyword: Substring matching can affect unrelated hosts. The configured Global inputs did not corroborate the exact keyword with this scope.
reason_descriptions.global_parent: Independent sources corroborate only narrower child names. The expanded parent suffix is held.
reason_descriptions.global_conflicting_parent: The Global source supports only cg.play-analytics.com, while its direct list marks the parent suffix. The broader replacement is held.
reason_descriptions.global_unconfirmed: No independent source verified that this exact match belongs to the Global ruleset.

evidence_fields.sources: Source references, optionally with the line number and verbatim rule.
evidence_fields.rdap: Source reference, registered network name, country, first address, last address.
evidence_fields.geo: Source reference, country, percent of the candidate network.
evidence_fields.dns: DNS source reference and returned values, or lookup references documenting NXDOMAIN.
